status: draft — pending clinical review. Safety behaviours to try dropping during an exposure, and to notice afterwards.

items.name: Asking for reassurance
items.example: Checking with someone that it will be okay.

items.name: Checking
items.example: Going back to make sure, again and again.

items.name: Avoiding eye contact
items.example: Looking down or away so no one engages.

items.name: Holding the phone as an escape
items.example: Keeping it ready to call someone or look busy.

items.name: Leaving early
items.example: Going before the hard part, or as soon as it rises.

items.name: Distracting myself
items.example: Counting, scrolling or humming so it doesn't register.
